label: Vlasy ve větru
desc: Lehký vánek zvedne vlasy, zastrčí si pramen za ucho, ohlédne se přes rameno.
desc_en: A light breeze lifts the hair, tucks a strand behind the ear, a glance back over the shoulder.
style_tail: , static camera, soft natural light, photorealistic, one slow continuous movement, calm steady tempo
negative: blurry, low quality, watermark, text, distorted face, extra fingers, extra limbs, deformed hands

beats.prompt: a light breeze slowly lifts their hair and lets it drift across their face and shoulders, the person blinks softly, and the hair settles again as the breeze fades
the person raises one hand, tucks a loose strand of hair behind their ear, then lowers the hand back to their side and stands still
the person turns their head to look over their shoulder, hair swinging with the turn, then turns back to the camera and ends with a soft smile
